caesar.help: Rotate the inner ring (drag, scroll wheel, or ← → keys) until the text becomes readable. Align the tallest ciphertext bar with the language's most frequent letter.
transposition.emptyTrace: Drag a path across the cells to build the text…

transposition.highlightHint: Click any letter to highlight every occurrence of it in the grid.

frequency.ngramHelp: Drag across 2–3 letters — the system highlights every identical cluster in the text.
